description: Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) is the foundation of data communication for the World Wide Web. On port 80, it is unencrypted.
real_world_incidents: Firesheep demonstrated the ease of session hijacking over open HTTP networks.
recommended_actions: Redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS via 301.

audience_guidance.student: HTTP sends data in plain text. Anyone on the same network can read it.
audience_guidance.developer: Ensure all endpoints immediately redirect to port 443 with a 301 status.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Check if sensitive functionality (like login) works over HTTP.
audience_guidance.pentester: Sniff traffic on the network to capture credentials or session cookies.
audience_guidance.security_team: Enforce strict transport security across the organization and monitor for unencrypted HTTP traffic.
